scientific_integrity: The proof reduces the unbounded parameter to a 147-state min-plus matrix and verifies an entrywise exact recurrence; direct finite enumeration independently checks all small orders. No claim of external validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimum only; no unrestricted census of all minimum identifying codes.
The infinite proof uses an explicitly reproducible finite computation of the matrix recurrence.
Historical overlap in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: A seven-periodic total-identifying domination law for prism graphs
